newsitem.title: USA: Group has 5.5 pct stake in Moore Corp.
newsitem.headline: Group has 5.5 pct stake in Moore Corp.

text.p: A Fort Worth, Texas-based investor group said Tuesday it has a 5.5 percent stake, or 4,810,329 common shares, in Moore Corp Ltd.

The group, which said it holds the stake for investment purposes, said it expects to have talks with Moore's management about various operational and financial issues. It also said it may have discussions with management and other shareholders about ways of "maximizing long-term shareholder value."

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group including TMI-FW Inc said it most recently bought shares between June 19 and July 25 at prices ranging from $19.69 to $20.47 a share.
